title: Microsoft (NasdaqGS:MSFT) Stock Forecast & Analyst Predictions
content:
Microsoft reported fiscal Q3 2026 revenue of US$82.9b, with Azure revenue rising 40% and AI revenue at a US$37b annual run rate, while investors focused on projected 2026 capital expenditure of about US$190b and the effect on margins and free cash flow. At Build 2026, the company introduced a broad set of in-house AI models, new AI-focused hardware such as Project Solara and Surface RTX Spark Dev Box, and the Microsoft Scout AI agent, aiming to rely less on external providers like OpenAI and [...] Reported Earnings • Jan 29
